description_expanded: Welcome to Blessing on the Beach, a magnificent Gulf-front home located in Panama City Beach! With a private pool, game room, elevator, and more, this spacious beachfront paradise is ideal for year-round vacationing and the perfect home for a large family retreat! Blessing on the Beach is a gorgeous three-story home with five bedrooms and five and a half baths accommodating up to 16. Beautifully furnished and fully appointed, this peaceful retreat welcomes you to experience the ultimate in luxury living. The home's first level features a private pool, a game room, and a cozy bedroom with a large walk-in closet and an en suite bathroom. A wet bar just steps from the pool deck ensures cool drinks are always close by! Use the stairs or elevator to access the second floor with a spacious, beautifully appointed kitchen, upgraded appliances, plenty of counter and cabinet space, and everything needed to prepare delicious meals for friends and family. Map out the day’s excursions at the large dining table, curl up on the cozy pit sofa, and catch up on your favorite shows on the flat-screen TV. The balcony will surely be a favorite spot for grilling burgers and steaks or just relaxing and enjoying the sea breezes. The third level of this stunning retreat includes a guest suite with two queen-sized beds and a gorgeous en suite bathroom. The kids will delight in having their own space, complete with two twin bunks, a flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom. A stunning master suite offers a comfortable king-sized bed, an en suite bathroom, and incredible views of the Gulf of Mexico. Start your day each morning on the balcony with a fresh cup of coffee, watching breathtaking sunrises over the sugar-white sands below. A full-sized washer and dryer are additional conveniences to enjoy during your stay! Private beach access from this peaceful retreat will lead straight to some of the world's most beautiful beaches. Relax the days away, soaking up the sun, but don’t forget you’re in the perfect location for exploration. Head west and hit the coastal communities of 30A, with Inlet Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Alys Beach just minutes away. Head east and hit Pier Park, Gulf World Marine Park, and Shipwreck Island Water Park for days of adventure! Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
